back.hook: useFrameBack() in FamilyFrame.tsx; FamilyChrome and TodayChrome call frame.back() before the route back
back.screen_N_gt_0: Goes to screen N−1. Label becomes “BACK TO SCREEN N”.
back.screen_0: The family’s original back (e.g. BACK TO TODAY / BACK TO MONEY / BACK TO CREDIT).

forward.visibility: Only when there is a next screen

history: No history entries, no URL change (history.length and pathname unchanged across NEXT/BACK, proven live). The browser / OS back gesture therefore leaves the route, as it did before.

accessibility.region: role=region, aria-label “{FAMILY} — SCREEN n OF m”, tabIndex −1
accessibility.focus: Moves to the region on every screen change (never on first render)
accessibility.offscreen: aria-hidden + inert — hidden panels cannot be tabbed into

reset: FrameProvider is keyed by pathname: opening another route starts at screen 1.
